notes.title: Cardboard Baler Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Let’s welcome a new friendly device called the Cardboard Baler: it should save trips to the trash spots for both players and employees.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new device: the Cardboard Baler. These can be placed anywhere in the storage and when players or employees deposit 10 empty boxes in them, a cardboard bale will be returned. Bales can be recycled for their equivalent in funds. Restockers will use the closest one to their positions and the storage crew will be the responsible to detect and carry bales if they haven’t got anything else to do.

- Fixed an issue in which supermarket letters would always glow green independently of chosen color after loading the game.

- Implemented two new option settings: being able to disable offensive NPCs comments and being able to set camera’s FOV while in blackboard events. Players with a different screen aspect ratio may find this last option useful so everything fits their screen.

- Images’ borders in picture frames should now adjust to the edges correctly.

- Staffroom’s jail corner and the jail itself can now be painted.

- Fixed a critical issue related to one product (gaming console) with wrong data assigned. Some scripts interacting with it could cause rare crashing or just plain errors.

- Fixed some colliders in the main scene being negative (interactions sometimes would return spammy messages in logs).

- Fixed an obscure issue in which there would be a small chance a customer with a custom shopping list would do literally no shopping due to an error in the randomness of the behavior.

- Extra advancements have been done (and also undone) regarding Order Packaging. Gameplay decisions are still being considered.

notes.title: Electronics I patch
notes.notes:
This patch includes a few more products and lights that can be placed outside. For players with persisting employees’ pathing problems a pinned topic will be created soon with further troubleshooting.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new product group: Electronics, and for now 6 products belonging to it including batteries, universal TV remotes and phone chargers. More related to electronics may arrive soon.

- Added 17 new types of street lights to the lighting tab, they are meant for exterior but if players want to place them inside the store who are we to judge.

- Added a new simple perk which improves customer’s speed when self-checkouting.

- Added a new cheap star perk which reduces electrical consumption by a 20% by implementing low energy bulbs.

- if a loan has been asked, the interface container in the invoices’ tab should now show the amount left to pay and day dues.

- An issue in which players could not activate the escape menu while in a camera event or chatting and while the host disconnects should be gone.

- Fixed a small issue in which Save/Load employees’ priorities were showing wrong task color in one of its values.

- Added a first automatic iteration of Hungarian localization. For corrections create a forums topic. Also huge corrections in the Korean localization.

- Optimized some textures for a small reduction in GPU memory.

- Implemented in the background compensated shopping lists for NPCs for a coming soon update. These will allow p.e. to sometimes have a customer to buy only snacks or alcohol for a party, or a customer that only needs cleaning products, or a customer to rarely purchase more expensive goods like incoming electronics…

notes.title: Staffroom Update
notes.notes:
This is the first staffroom patch, which may play a role in the future related to employees’ performance improvement. A first ‘beta’ of the TVs autosync option is publicly available starting with Youtube, note that a small percentage of videos, especially famous music, fail to embed correctly in non-host players with the message ‘This video is unavailable’ and solutions are being checked to circumvent this.
More sites suggestions to sync are welcomed and their implementation progress will depend on their technical difficulty as the ingame’s browser code has to be manually hooked into the game’s one. 

Changelog:
- Added a new tab in the Builder: the Staffroom, with 6 new props and more arriving in the future. Employees will probably move there soon.

- Added a new device: the robot cleaner. Its recharging deck can only be placed in the storage.

- Did the first integration of autosyncing for the TVs starting with Youtube and will improve it over time. Note the following points:
* Both sides, host and clients, must toggle the new ‘Autosync’ option in the TVs monitor panel in order to activate the feature. Hosts also have a toggle in which they can let joining clients alter the played video by using the browser’s URL bar.
* Although most link patterns should work correctly, the most recognizable are like this example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K4TOrB7at0Y 
* Each player could have their own instance of ads and miss part of the video respecting the host.

- Added two new achievements related to the surveillance desk.

- Added a toggle in the pricing machine for players who don’t want their prices rounded down to first decimal.

- Added a bar to input any URL in the browser and increased its scrolling sensitivity.

- Visually fixed Checkout B money amounts being flipped with their respective coins/papers.

- Player names and customers messages should now look at the player correctly when in a surveillance camera.

- Further optimized some products meshes and made Crab Sticks stack without overlapping.

- Fixed an issue in which you could drop objects via the CCTV camera.

- Corrected half shelves slight visual overlap with other furniture types.

notes.title: CCTV + Surveillance Desk Update
notes.notes:
The robot cleaner hasn’t been able to make it to this patch but will be implemented soon and can be previewed in the manager’s room. There have also been advancements for the TV sync update right now bottlenecked by the needed of hooking the game’s programming language with the own’s ingame browser.

Changelog:
- Introduced two new devices: 
* The CCTV camera: having a certain number of cameras passively reduces thievery chance up to a 10% in multiplayer games and 25% in single player games.
* The surveillance desk: players can iterate between all placed camera’s POVs and do a small minigame in which they can click on customers and discover thieves, a discovered thief will not steal and will be forced to checkout. The closest the distance from the camera to the customer the more effective the clicking is, where will you place your cameras?

- Fixed an issue in which players could push themselves while placing a Simple or Double Fridge.

- Fixed an issue in which you couldn’t delete Hanging Lamp I.

- Fixed an issue in which NPCs could go through the new Half Shelf.

- Fixed an issue in which Ka-ching volume could still be heard even after setting it to 0, also fixed master volume not affecting it.

- Fixed an issue in which having more than 10 millions would display funds in interface wrong.

- Introduced the last tweaks to save system and now Steam Cloud saving is active. Also game’s inclusion in Geforce Now has been requested.

- Merged and optimized certain textures sizes for a small GPU performance gain.

notes.title: Mid-November Patch: More Lights!
notes.notes:
Hello! Steam Cloud saving system will probably be activated around tomorrow if all testings go correctly, that also means adding the game to Geforce Now is one step closer.

Changelog:
- Implemented 17 new lights in its respective Builder tab.

- Added a half version of the current custom shelf as new furniture.

- Added new options settings:
* An option to toggle always running mode (Shift key would then be used to walk)
* An option for deactivating browser, this doesn’t work ingame and has to be set from main menu.
* Two options to change crosshair size and color.
* An option to confine mouse cursor inside the window.
* An option to modify night dim factor. This mitigates the auto-exposure correction during night, a factor of 0 will deactivate it.

- Added a new field in the pricing machine and now prices can be set via percentage, it also rounds prices automatically down to first decimal. For quickly price setting, select he percentage, keep selecting products and then press the assigned key to numpad accept.

- Gave more height to basic fridge and double fridge, this fixes bottles not entirely fitting them and makes products like yoghurt win a stack.

- Door transit states should now be saved between sessions.

- Fixed an issue in which player’s footsteps would stop sounding for a moment after leaving the vehicle.

- Employees will now try to ignore the new door transit system.

- Load Store menu area is now scrollable.

- Optimized the geometry of plenty of products for a small performance gain, some of them will be retweaked again.

- Tweaked some vehicle parameters to check if there are improvements to the teleport or floating players issue.

notes.title: New Products And Snapping Patch
notes.notes:
Changelog:

- 13 new products related to child care. Diapers, baby food, milk & milk powder, cleaning wipes, etc. Franchise perks are located parting from pharmacy.

- Added 3 modes of snapping in the builder (left control key by default, reassignable):
* Free mode: no snapping.
* Grid center: centers perfectly to grid and subgrid nodes. Useful for decoration, lights or anything that should be set every x distance.
* Furniture snap: snaps furniture together. Have to look at the side of the furniture players want to have their new prop snapped.
Note grid snapping is not that useful for big furniture placing and may implement a secondary mode that aligns props backside to the grid.

- Store door transits can now be customized via a panel above each door, states are: open, only entrance, only exit and closed. Panels won’t work if that leads to an unsupported combination for customers p.e. all doors closed. Doors lack closing/opening animations for now.

- New first iterations for these localizations: Portuguese, Polish and Czech.

- Modified self checkout pivot which was needed for better snapping. This might lead to bad positioning when loading the game so players might have to readjust them again.

- Added a vertical array of icons for each tab in the Builder for better visual navigation.

- Widened the two doors that go from boxes spawn point to warehouse.

 - Products in boxes carried by employees or players should now be added up correctly to the total box counts in manager blackboard.

- Disabled most Halloween content excepting props and paintables.

- Have modified how saving game settings work as a previous step to allow Steam Cloud saving. If any player notices a game setting not saving successfully between sessions feel free to report.

- Replaced some icons in the perk’s blackboard for some more fitting ones.

- Players are now not able to delete the last manned checkout and will receive a warning.

- Fixed an issue in which trash would barely spawn in higher difficulties.

- Increased a few products count in boxes including toilet paper which goes from 6 to 8.

We are not forgetting most requested features among others: better vehicle handling, more employees and their customization, a more straight forward way of sync TVs content like Youtube, more permissions/roles variety, cloud saving activation, etc.

notes.title: October End Patch
notes.notes:
Small patch which introduces the first drivable vehicle. The next feature we want to study its implementation is grid snapping + furniture snapping.

Halloween music, ghosts and extra props visible in city will disappear this incoming weekend but decoration and paintables will persist in case players want to use them.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new prop under the devices menu tab: the Mini Transport Vehicle. It is rideable by players and allow 6 boxes to be carried on it. Since it is its first implementation there could be problems that will be solved over time. Controls are:
* WASD to accelerate, decelerate and turn.
* E to get out
* F to honk
* Space and right click to do a tiny hop forward or backward respectively in case it gets stuck somehow or for some stubborn walkway.
Boxes remaining in the transport will not save for now so make sure to store them before leaving the game.

- Added 24 new achievements and the respective ingame stats tracking for them to work. Achievements are normally awarded at the end of day. 

- Related to previous point, the cat can now be petted.

- Added a shortcut button in manager blackboard to order all the current products in view at once. It is the big + located in the bottom right corner of the area.

- Moved the 4x recycling box perk in the tree so it’s more useful early game.

- Modified tutorial to not mention the deprecated tablet.

- Restored TVs collision which was removed long ago due to not having tables at hand could cause players to get stuck.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Spooky times are upon us.

Changelog:
- Halloween update additions which include:
* A new tab in the Builder for seasonal Halloween decorations with 13 props.
* 16 new Halloween paintables.
* 37 new hats.
* New music tracks exclusive for Halloween both for main menu and ingame.
* A small ingame mini-event.

- Added a new machine in the devices tab that allows all prices to be changed from there. It is meant for commodity in advanced stores so its price is set for now at 90.000$.

- Boxes have now each a different color depending on the product group they contain. Brown for basic products, white for pharmacy, blue for seafood, etc.

- Products in the manager blackboard are now organized by their common group instead of each having their own tier. P.e. Basic Products I, II, III etc is now only Basic Products.

- Pressing escape in single player stores will now pause the game.

- Reassigned numpad keys now should work correctly for credit card checkouting.

- Store won’t be able to be opened without at least one manned checkout and will give a warning.

- To prevent accidental deleting it is not possible to remove a container furniture until it is emptied of all its products or boxes.

- An issue which prevented coop players to give extra funds has been fixed, this was useful for multiplayer faster starts and have less value in ongoing games.

notes.title: Weekly patch - Builder rework
notes.notes:
Hullo! There have been big changes related to the Builder and decoration tablet so make sure to check the logs below.

Changelog:
- Decoration tablets have been deprecated and all their contents moved to the Builder, which now features several tabs. Two new keys (Z and X) allow changing tabs, they can be reassigned in options to inputs of player’s convenience. This will help reorganizing items better when more arrive (a separate tab for lights, devices, decoration, etc.)

- An improvement related to previous point: decoration can now be moved with the builder instead of having to delete and rebuy it for repositioning.

- Deleting is now done from the builder in a new element just below Place Mode.

- Reworking the builder has now allowed being able to delete big furniture during nights but players will have to dispatch all customers first and wait until they leave the area. Currently the only way to do so was during mornings.

- Added 10 more expansions to the store to be acquired.

- Added an extra door for customer access along with its extra entrance space (available since Day 1).

- Since the auxiliar door left to the store was removed for new expansions, doors are now permanently opened for convenience.

- New additional furniture for produce, it’s less cumbersome than produce A and three of them should barely fit between pillars. Produce A can now have two stacks of most trays except artichokes to compensate its volume.

- Added a self-checkout furniture for 2500$. They won’t replace normal checkouts entirely as customers with a lot of items will not prefer them but they do help a lot nevertheless. As they are customer manned, they have a slower product checkout speed and there’s a tiny chance a product won’t be checked in (won’t affect statistics), chance that is increased with difficulty.

- The issue in the pre-patch where self-checkout wouldn’t count towards franchise experience and income should be solved.

- Improved customers shopping list pathing, they should be more efficient and do not roam the store so much which inherently means more customers per day.

- Dances and numpad keys required for pricing or credit card checkouting are now assignable in options (22 new assignments). Players using Numpad Plus for deleting values may have to reassign it in Controls.

- Improved certain behaviors performance, the FPS gain can be up to a 15% especially in the case of big stores.

notes.title: Eat Healthy Patch
notes.notes:
Hullo! This is the first update related to produce: small fruit and vegetables are organized in trays for convenience but we are considering also including bins or baskets for “in-bulk” products. With this patch the total product amount available rises to 214.

Changelog:
- Implemented 23 new products related to produce: red/green apples, clementines, oranges, pears, lemons, mangoes, avocados, kiwis, papayas, strawberries, cherries, artichokes, zucchinis, carrots, tomatoes, po-ta-toes, onions, bananas, melons, pineapples, pumkins and watermelons.

- Implemented a new furniture piece: the produce shelf A. This will probably be the last furniture piece before reworking the builder menu as it seems cramped right now. More shelves will arrive, as well as a more vertical furniture piece for produce.

- Added four new storage modules to be bought and will probably add soon another row but for the store itself.

- Started to implement several optimization features, there should be in certain cases between +10% and +25% FPS boost in fully upgraded stores with dense furniture or storage. Extra optimization features are planned to be added as adding more features is starting to take its toll on performance.

- Empty boxes can now be bought from the Manager’s blackboard. The image shown in the box will be random.

- Restocking employees will now try to merge leftover box contents with others in storage if they exist.

- Added a new switch in the employee’s blackboard in case players want to interrupt box recycling.

- Slightly displaced store’s end’s wall for better furniture fitting there.

- Modified avoidance radius for employees, this will make them less prone to get stuck with each other but also will make them overlap visually more. Feel free to report if there are still issues with them to further tweak their values.

- Added a visual effect for products checkouting, they will drop themselves inside newly added bags in each checkout. Visual effects and animations will be slowly added.

notes.title: Customization Update
notes.notes:
How’s everyone? The first iteration of the customization update is now available for public testing: fully painting the store and annex facilities should cost between 300.000$ (with cheap materials) to 4.000.000$ (if you pave it in gold!) Have fun experimenting, more materials will be added in the future.

Changelog for this week:
- Implemented the first customization update. Players will be able to use the green tablet to paint up to around 3500 entities including most floors, ceilings and walls. Pillars and beams will be customizable when possible as they require some particular changes as well as the exterior facades.

- Removed the vents for now as they made painting the ceiling difficult and implemented a new decoration to compensate: the ceiling vent.

- Reorganization: there’s a new room outside the store which will act as a restroom and players will be able to decorate with custom furniture in a future patch. Also moved the jail there. 

- At least one of the security employees will now pick up dropped stolen products. The rest will stand guard.

- Improved product placement: they should appear perfectly centered on each container type.

- Introduced a storage shelf variant with no labels so new storage system can now be combined with the old one. We will sort a bit better the builder furniture list in a future rework.

- Detergents and Hand Soap now face forward correctly.

- Made some fixes and rebaked the pathing for customers and employees, they shouldn’t go in the area outside storage anymore.

- Hosts can now open and close their games willingly with a new button in escape menu. Players will be unable to join a closed game.

- Slightly Reduced thieving chance for coop games but increased max selectable difficulty from 7 to 10.

- Adjusted storage shelf width which was slightly higher in one of it sides.

notes.title: Mid-September Patch: New Products
notes.notes:
Is it a plane, is it an UFO? No, it’s your employees being able to chase those pesky thieves. 
Changelog:

- Added two new product franchises: Pharmacy I and Pharmacy II which will branch from Hygiene in the perks blackboard. Includes stuff like basic medicines, vitamins, etc. The next franchises added will probably be fruits and vegetables.

- Added a new store furniture piece: the standing freezer.

- Added a first iteration of security role for employees. They will try to run after thieves and hit them but won’t pick up products from the floor for now. 

- Implemented a network core change that will hopefully reduce latency for placing products in those who sometimes have missing items when restocking.

- Players can now merge boxes contents by clicking a box with the same product in a storage shelf. Being able to do so directly in boxes isn’t implemented yet as ground boxes don’t show their quantity for now.

- Clients should now be able to check each number of products in ground boxes in the manager’s blackboard. This doesn’t count the boxes players are carrying around yet (both for host and clients).

- Added two new options: Bloom setting (useful if you have overlighting in your store) and turning off videos generally (some old graphics card won’t support this feature).

- Adjusted some products for better performance, should scratch some FPS especially in bigger stores.

- Fixed an issue in which a franchise point was automatically awarded every time the game was loaded. (In ongoing games It should happen only once again and then not anymore)

- Customers paying with money should pay with less weirder amounts of money when value is high.

- Red beans, big tuna and premium soda now face forward correctly.

- Fixed an issue in which employees would go through the store’s doors when closed.

- Reduced thieves max speed and they will roam around a bit more.

- Fixed an issue in which cheese bags would get in front of price label inside fridges.

notes.title: September Preparatory Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings supermarket owners. This week has been mostly focused to prepare some core changes to network and saving system as this was a necessary pre-step for adding more perks or products and adding paint customization. We are also improving employees so apologies if they behave weirdly these days while we are tweaking them. Changelog:

- Added fourteen new employee related perks, they will probably change position in the blackboard as more stuff is added:
* Five perks for five additional employees.
* Three perks to have faster checkout speed.
* Two perks to have faster product placement
* Three perks to have even faster movement speed.
* One perk to have employees recycle boxes.

- Saving system has received core changes. Saving and loading should be way faster now and problems related to props missing in some saves should be mitigated as the game now access the data folder way less times.

- Day statistics won’t end automatically and will now wait for the host to press a key. Clients will have to wait for the host.

- Storage shelves will now remember the last product placed in them, that way employees will sort them accordingly. A label in each spot will show the product that was previously there. Spots can be cleared with the pricing tool the same way that with shelves.  (The issue present in the past weekend pre-patch where storage employees wouldn’t work should be gone).

- Employees will now prioritize restocking most empty shelves and keep iterating up to the more filled ones. In most cases several employees shouldn’t focus on the same shelf anymore.

- Employees should now go directly to another shelf if has products remaining in box instead of the current behavior in which they would return each time to storage box.

- The issue in which employees wouldn’t restock shelves until their full capacity should be fixed.

- Added a bamboo variation of the new potted spruce decoration plant.

- Added a history to chat text messages.

- Fixed an issue in which you could build or move new furniture inside decoration.

- Fixed an issue in which player’s speed was faster while moving in diagonal.

notes.title: Early September Patch Changelog
notes.notes:
Changelog for this week:

- Customers will now try to do a straight queue at checkouts.

- Base game version now can now choose the gender of the starter character in main menu. Two new characters have been added to the DLC skins.

- Added a product search field in Manager’s blackboard.

- Added a first rework of TVs: a monitor in the cool room allows several options:
* Turning them off.
* Allow some default videos included in the game to be repeated in a loop. This is the default option also in the base game.
* Allow local videos or online videos URLs. Input must end in a supported video format: mp4, mov, avi…
* Hook the browser to TVs: note this has a small performance overhead and volume may be dependant on each webpage. Most non-stream features should work.

- New decoration prop: a bigger potted plant, meant for outdoors but can also be placed indoors.

- Product name and brand are now added on carried boxes.

- Checkout cash and notes have a sound when interacting with them.

- Fixed an issue in which player’s view would stay in the Manager’s blackboard when jailed.

- Introduced player crouching. Binded to C by default and customizable in Options. Some items and animations will have to be polished since this feature was not intended to be present.

- Some improvements to products placement: 
* Coke can packs will now be placed in two rows on shelves instead of just one.
* Smoked salmon, parma ham and sliced ham now fit in bigger quantities in both single and double fridges.
* Rotated margarine and soda bottles to face forward.
* Adjusted veal and chicken wings trays which were displayed weirdly.
* Changed chopped beef and chicken wings tray color.

- Drastically reduced thieves spawn chance in solo games with difficulty zero.

- Fixed an issue in which the builder grid wasn’t visible in part of the ceiling.

- Added a first iteration of RU & UK localizations. Feel free to report if there are problems with Cyrillic characters visualization. More localizations will arrive when possible.

- Fixed one of the issues in which some characters skins arms would display weirdly.

notes.title: August End Patch Changelog
notes.notes:
Hello! Changelog for this week:
- Added a new prop: the Door Anti-Theft system, it will beep when a pesky thief passes between it.

- Implemented the first iteration of player control, by pressing escape hosts can:
* Kick players
* Remove global permissions for doing anything. More particular permissions may arrive in a latter iteration.
* Punish players or lazy friends by jailing them, the punish amount is the number of times jailed players will have to click on the door to open it. It can be also used as a way to unstuck players by the host.

- A chat message will pop up when a new player joins.

- Red areas in which is forbidden to build will also show now while using the decoration tablet as they show with Builder mode.

- Build mode has now an auxiliar grid. Snapping is on the to-do list.

- When a thief is out of products to drop, the symbol above its head will disappear from now on.

- Playing an emote will now be done in Third Person mode so they can be visualized.

- Products tier buttons remain highlighted when selected in Manager Blackboard.

- Shopping list in Manager Blackboard can now be scrolled down.

- Cleared furniture removal for now during nights, this caused certain problems especially if there were customers still around.

- Fixed an issue in which hat and character 0 IDs wouldn’t save from one game to another. Also applied to employees.

- Changed chicken mix product to a different color as it was very similar to another frozen food.

- Frozen food bag products now fit two rows in Freezers instead of one.

- Tutorial on day 1 will now disappear when opening the supermarket straightaway.

- Moved all grated cheese bags from shelves to fridge.

- Carried box now show required container.

- Players can now build in the store’s doors but if every entrance is blocked customers may misbehave (go through stuff)

- Related to the LocError problem, it is now mitigated by forcing the system language even if the selected language fails to be loaded from the GameOptions file present in the save folder. It will also throw an error to the logs which will help pinpointing the issue.

- Added some more music tracks.

Extra news: paintables have been selected for the future implementation of the store customization tablet. It will feature around 90 different materials and will arrive when possible during these next weeks.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Changelog
notes.notes:
Thanks for your patience: apart from the feedback in forums and events logs we also receive lots of mails every day. In order to work in an organized way we’ll push the changelog around every Wednesday with few exceptions.

Changelog:
- Implementation of a new prop: the Basic Crowd Barrier, useful for redirecting the stream of those playful customers. Next public prop will be probably the door anti-theft beeping system.

- Game will now generate backups of your game per day, you can recover any last 10 days from the Load Store screen. Note that if up to this patch you had a corrupted save, the backups will be corrupted too sadly.

- Implemented changing difficulty on started games via the Load Store screen.

- Implemented being able to delete games via the Load Store screen.

- Customers have now a new internal system to place products in a faster way. It is really noticeable in advanced days.

- Looking at a shelf will now show some product’s info in the global interface, useful for shelves that previously contained products.

- Related to previous point, players can now totally reset a shelf’s product by pressing right click on it with the pricing item. A beep will confirm its success. This will make employees finally ignore shelves that players don’t want to be filled anymore.

- Reduced the pillars colliders just barely enough for 4 shelves to fit between them for perfectionist players.

- Extended the decoration boundaries to include the walkway in front of the store.

- Game will now wait for saving before returning to main menu or quitting the application. By analyzing saves some players sent as “bugged”, plenty of them seemed broken because quitting the game while saving OR they were overwritting a previous corrupted game. In any case backups are there to mitigate this issue.

- Walls between storage rooms have been demolished. Also reduced the width of the wall that separates storage from store so players might want to reposition their shelves.

- Butter now goes in fridges and is stackable vertically. If you have butter placed in shelves they might display incorrectly until you move them to a fridge.

- Fixed an issue in which players would move while in camera manager mode.

- Fixed an issue in which funds notifications would show as -0$.

- Fixed the products icons in the manager blackboard that showed Refrigerator instead of Freezer.

- Fixed an issue in which selecting hat ID 0 wouldn’t remove it.

- Modified some general values based on player’s progression feedback, including earning franchise points which is now faster at start and slower later.

- Fixed some products like the detergent or the big peas that wouldn’t face forward the shelf. There could be a few more.

- Added some more music tracks.


Extra news: 
- Hosts will notice that now Escape menu has a list with the rest of players, this is the precursor of the menu that will allow players to kick, punish friends and give a global use permission (will try to extend later to more particular permissions but this is more delicate to implement as the entire code has to be modified).
- Players having problems with saves will find tomorrow a new pinned topic with instructions about how to send logs and a sample Store File which can be downloaded for testing.
- If by next monday we haven’t heard replies from the propietary codecs owners to get the necessary license for TVs to work we’ll consider other options to at least hook the browser (we want this feature as much as you do).
Also DLC owners know that the arrival of the painting tablet is estimated during the first half of September. Exclusive props will arrive between patches here and there when possible.

PD: thanks to everybody that bought the support DLC, we have our daily jobs and this gives us some more resources to buy stuff to improve the game.

notes.title: Midweek patch + Hanging Banner prop
notes.notes:
Hullo! Some of this features were added as smaller hotfixes during previous days. Remember it’s important for all players to keep the version of the game updated to last patch so there are no synchronization issues. There are some notifications about most reported issues at the end of the post.

Changelog:
- Added a new decoration: the Hanging Banner, you will be able to choose 15 different colors for it and set whatever text you want in it.

- [b]Important:[/b] related to previous point and since players will need keyboard for typing, to close the manager’s blackboard or the ceiling label menu players will now have to press escape or just press the newly created [X] button in interface. WASD won’t work anymore.

- Implemented the use of numpad for setting prices. Still have to modify tutorial to mention the feature.

- Players are now allowed to adjust FOV in options. Added a new volume slider as well to adjust TVs volume for the future. Fixed an issue in which a low FOV prevented correct manager’s blackboard visualization

- Thiefs will drop now more than 1 item per hit depending on the amount of total items stolen.

- Thiefs will no longer leave directly using the short path right to supermarket. They will roam around in the street outside a bit more.

- Reduced the chance of thievery for single player games, for more thieves you can inflate difficulty.

- Fixed an issue in which players could discover thieves before they would flee.

- Tutorial being stuck on clients should be solved now. Separate clients would still need to do certain steps so they don’t miss anything like taking a box or leaning to use the manager blackboard.

- Fixed an issue in which you could press the opening store button during nights to not avail but the notification popped up.

- Fixed an issue in which pressing P while chatting would open the escape menu.

- Minimized an issue in which you could have insane amounts of a product in a box.

- Fixed an issue in which some employees would go through some storage walls.

- Slightly adjusted given franchise experience down.

- Brightness correction while in the store during nights has been tweaked (a bit more bright)

- TVs no longer block players.

- Fixed an issue in which special perks like hiring an employee did not use a franchise point.

- Current day now shows in UI (the text right to current hour)

- Fixed an issue in which cursor would disappear if you pressed escape while navigating the manager’s blackboard.

- Fixed an issue in which player would get frame freezes when highlighting some furniture with the tablet.

- Fixed an issue in which refunding items would also get franchise experience.

We are aware of the main most reported issues:
1- That the state of public lobbies looks right now more like Mortal Kombat than a simulator. The tools for some control are in the making but they will require some time and testing on our side, for now there’s an unofficial Discord pinned in topics so you can get some buddies to do legal work with you.

2- Some issues of game not saving. Until we can pinpoint the exact issue we will implement some features to mitigate this, including generation of backups per day (you will be able to return to the day the game worked correctly and that will gives us better feedback as we will be able to compare a working file with its bugged counterpart).

3- Some few cases of game’s freezing when joining a store. While there could be some existing network problems that trigger with particular clients, always make sure that your external firewall or related security measures aren’t blocking the game’s communication with Steam.
The classic “Windows Firewall has blocked some features of this app” when you first run an application could make the game not being able to communicate with Steam for lobby synchronization.

notes.title: The weekend patch!
notes.notes:
Hey ho! More fixes:
- Players can now delete furniture like shelves or checkouts from the tablet the same way they delete decoration. 90% of the cost will be refunded. Two important things:
* Can only sell furniture at 8pm before opening.
* For now contents inside containers will be DELETED. Make sure you empty shelves of products or storage of boxes before deleting. This will change and give you a warning in the future.

- Numpad can now be used to checkout with credit card. Including backspace, you can also use + and – to delete the input. (Setting prices with numpad coming soon).

- The speed at which now customers place items on checkout will be faster each new day until hitting a certain limit.

- Carried box is now moved to the side a bit when looking down, that way freezer’s products are visible.

- Important: Introduced a saving icon on new day so players know when to quit the game. This could alleviate some people’s problems because missing props probably due to disconnecting while saving.

- Fixed an issue in which acquiring an expansion would cost the next expansion’s price.

- Minimized the issue in which you could duplicate boxes by dropping and leaving it in a storage box or trying to recycle it for infinite money. Also to get a free item when you did the same to a shelf.

- Dropped boxes on ground will now appear oriented to the player.

- Removed the glitch in which you could quickly drop and take a box in order to try to duplicate it. Doing this now may result in being punished by losing the toy.

- Restockers NPCs should now refill shelves almost to the limit.

- Fixed in issue in which some players’ games would only show one public room in listings.

- Fixed an issue in which checkouts where sometimes not saved. Report if this happens again as it is a tricky point and  there may be other complementary causes. (We will probably have to ask for savegames to pinpoint it)

- Fixed an issue in which you could acquire some perks before acquiring the previous tree node, including employees.

- Fixed an issue in which franchise level would display in a wrong way in statistics screen and earned franchise experience would display a wrong value.

- Perks in blackboard now won’t show in unlockables the next nodes it unlocks since it was too obvious and led to misunderstandings. Also corrected some nodes showing LocError or wrong unlocked products (there could be some few more)

- Trying to get a joining code in a solo/private game will return something interesting now.

- Freezer in Builder now shows a better icon.

We have heard about your problem in public matches. Trolls will always troll no matter how limited their role is and host will not notice toxic behaviour until it’s too late. While we will attempt to give host some tools to deal with this, perhaps our efforts should be better placed in trying to gather people that wants to play seriously together so they let naughty people… outside.

Also the size of the new patch is to prepare the game for some content arriving during this week.
